input.summary: Kovai Finechem (V01, contact R. Selvam, Sales). Sent offer in their own ERP format (Kovai_Finechem_Offer.xlsx) and a sample COA for propanediol only. Open: RM-002 glycerin quoted per litre with no density, so cannot convert to kg (tries 0/3). Knockout gaps open: COA for each line (B5) and SDS with transport class (H1). Asked to include density and conversion, OTIF, need-by date and strength/assay. Their reply was not yet checked against the questionnaire format. Response deadline 14 Nov 2026.

input.subject: RE: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Offer clarifications needed
input.body:
Dear Mr. Selvam,

Thank you for your offer and the propanediol COA. Your ERP format is acceptable. To complete our evaluation, please answer the following:

1. Glycerin (RM-002): your offer is per litre with no density. Please state the density in g/mL at a stated temperature, so we can convert the quote to kg. (Our need is 1,562 kg over 6 months.)
2. Conversion: give the conversion from your selling unit to kilograms of net material for each line (for example, 1 drum = 200 kg net). A completed Annexure A also meets this requirement.
3. Certificate of Analysis: provide a recent batch COA for each line, showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. We have the propanediol COA; please send the rest.
4. Safety Data Sheet: provide the current SDS for each line, including the transport hazard class.
5. Strength/assay: for each line, state the strength or assay, the marker it is measured against and the test method. Our specifications are 98% active for D-Panthenol, 500 ppm peptide for Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3, and 1,000 ppm peptide for Copper Tripeptide-1. If your strength differs, state the quantity needed to deliver the same active content.
6. Delivery: can you meet our first need-by date of 20 December 2026? If not, state your earliest date for the first delivery.
7. OTIF: state your on-time-in-full rate for these lines over the last 12 months and your definition of on-time.

Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
